pubcol-w-1625e5edf7e71784.definition_en: a file sent together with an email message
pubcol-w-1625e5edf7e71784.example_simple: I forgot to add the attachment to my email.
pubcol-w-1625e5edf7e71784.example_complex: The recruiter asked me to submit my CV as a PDF attachment rather than pasting it into the message body.

pubcol-w-38e4e4b0ad783ff9.definition_en: to make an effort to do something, especially something difficult
pubcol-w-38e4e4b0ad783ff9.example_simple: She will attempt to finish the report by Friday.
pubcol-w-38e4e4b0ad783ff9.example_complex: Despite the storm, the climbers decided to attempt the summit before conditions deteriorated further.

pubcol-w-600f311cf31f8446.definition_en: to be present at an event, meeting, or place
pubcol-w-600f311cf31f8446.example_simple: Students must attend all their lectures.
pubcol-w-600f311cf31f8446.example_complex: Delegates from more than fifty countries attended the international summit on climate change.

pubcol-w-f61b43b4164a1f11.definition_en: the fact of being present at an event, or the number of people present
pubcol-w-f61b43b4164a1f11.example_simple: The teacher checks attendance at the start of every class.
pubcol-w-f61b43b4164a1f11.example_complex: Falling attendance at the museum forced the trustees to rethink their pricing and marketing strategy.

pubcol-w-83f945711f63fbdf.definition_en: during the period of time between two events; meanwhile
pubcol-w-83f945711f63fbdf.example_simple: Dinner will be ready soon; in the meantime, please sit down.
pubcol-w-83f945711f63fbdf.example_complex: The new software will launch next month; in the meantime, staff should continue using the existing system.

pubcol-w-82197627c41452c7.definition_en: driving or in control of a vehicle, or in charge of an organisation
pubcol-w-82197627c41452c7.example_simple: He was at the wheel when the accident happened.
pubcol-w-82197627c41452c7.example_complex: With a seasoned executive at the wheel, the struggling company gradually returned to profitability.

pubcol-w-628912ee5037df8c.definition_en: a way of thinking or feeling about something, often shown in behaviour
pubcol-w-628912ee5037df8c.example_simple: A positive attitude helps you learn faster.
pubcol-w-628912ee5037df8c.example_complex: Her professional attitude and willingness to help made her the most respected member of the team.

collocations: back the wrong horse in an election
afraid to back the wrong horse
pubcol-w-78b5a47a3e0c8f7d.example_simple: By choosing that company, the investors backed the wrong horse.
pubcol-w-78b5a47a3e0c8f7d.example_complex: Analysts who dismissed the start-up soon realised they had backed the wrong horse when its rival collapsed.

pubcol-w-fc2def45f300cd14.example_simple: His joke backfired and made everyone angry.
